cases.prompt: Move this helper from one App into +labkit so a second App can use it.
cases.rationale: Helper promotion and multi-App ownership require a boundary decision.

cases.prompt: Add a new public labkit.app API for a repeated lifecycle problem in three Apps.
cases.rationale: A new public framework surface requires the public-boundary gate.

cases.prompt: Rename a private variable inside one App calculation.
cases.rationale: A private App-local rename cannot affect a shared boundary.

cases.prompt: Adjust spacing between two controls in an existing App layout.
cases.rationale: Presentation-only App-local work has no package ownership decision.

cases.prompt: Rename a private local variable in an SDK method; its owner, API, and dependencies stay unchanged.
cases.rationale: Private implementation maintenance does not require an ownership decision.

cases.prompt: The App needs a background device service with cancel and close behavior.
cases.rationale: Background lifecycle is a boundary decision.

cases.prompt: Let a public App call an NI vendor API directly when the driver happens to be installed.
cases.rationale: A vendor runtime and App-to-facade dependency exception require an explicit guarded boundary decision.
